ignoreValues.reason: User confirmed: the 62x5px hero score bar animates width so the quarter-round corner (canon 5 structural signature) stays crisp; scaleX distorts it and there is no measurable perf gain at that size

Canon 5 makes the hero grid load-bearing, not decorative: it is one of the named structural signatures of the ambient hero, drawn at 3 percent alpha (--wa03) behind a radial mask so it reads as texture under the H1 and fades before the copy. Sumeet ratified keeping it, 2 Aug 2026. Scoped to the three .heroGrid declarations that draw it; the rule stays live everywhere else.
